capabilities: Encrypt all vault files (notes, canvases, attachments) on disk with AES-256-GCM and Argon2id
Unlock the vault with a master password, biometrics, or auto-lock after inactivity
Recover a vault offline with a 24-word BIP-39 phrase
Export encrypted vault snapshots and upload them to WebDAV, Google Drive, or OneDrive
Scrub cryptographic keys from RAM on lock, timeout, or error
disambiguation: Not a per-note locking tool; it encrypts the entire vault transparently at the file-system level.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation via BRAT or manual download is documented while community-plugin review is pending. Detailed user, developer, and security manuals live outside the README.
intentEvidence: Before MySecret, you had two bad options: encrypt note by note with plugins like Meld Encrypt
motivation: The author saw two bad options: per-note encryption plugins like Meld Encrypt that break search, tags and graph view, or external containers like Cryptomator and VeraCrypt that are frustrating on Android.
problem: Obsidian stores notes and attachments as plaintext on disk, so anyone with access to the folder, a stolen laptop, or the cloud provider can read them.
